name: What is the difference between a pre-hung and slab door?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a pre-hung and slab door?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pre-hung door comes pre-assembled in its own frame, complete with hinges and sometimes a pre-drilled bore for hardware. It is ideal for new construction or when replacing an entire door frame, simplifying the installation process. A slab door, on the other hand, is just the door panel itself, without a frame, hinges, or hardware. Slab doors are suitable for replacing an existing door within an intact frame, requiring precise measurements and hardware installation on-site. Choosing between them depends on the condition of your existing frame and the scope of the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pre-hung door includes the frame and hardware, ideal for new installations or full frame replacements. A slab door is just the panel, used for replacing a door within an existing frame.
